''See also: [[Empire (Elder Empire) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Aurelian Empire]] is a vast civilization established following the [[Elder War]], an era marked by the defeat of the [[Great Elders]] who once ruled the world. [[The Empire]] is traditionally unified under a single Emperor, a figure of immense power who historically utilized the [[Optasia]]—a specialized throne and global network of receptors—to monitor and combat Elder activity. The Emperor's [[Authority{{!}}authority]] was bolstered by his ability to borrow power from the [[Elders]], granting him a form of immortality and the capacity to stand above humanity. However, following the death of the previous Emperor, [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]] has faced significant instability and the threat of fragmentation into separate kingdoms. In his absence, the realm is managed by four [[Regents]], though their leadership has led to political cracks and growing discontent among various factions. [[The Empire]]'s stability relies heavily on its [[Guilds]], such as the [[Blackwatch]], the [[Navigators]], and the [[Luminian Order]], which serve various roles in defense, travel, and social order. Despite these structures, [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]] remains under constant threat from the [[Great Elders]] and their various spawn, who seek to reclaim the world and dismantle human civilization.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|For five years, [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]] has been maintained by a group of four [[Regents]]. During this period, the state officially registered every [[Soulbound]] located on the continent and saw travelers journey across its various lands. While [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]] is governed by a ruler born of an Elder, the nation harbors a profound hatred for the [[Elders]] themselves. To protect its borders, the [[Blackwatch]] conducts studies on these [[Elders]], as [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]] faces the threat of total civilizational collapse without proper direction.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[The Empire]] has been held together for five years by four [[Regents]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 3</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[The Empire]] officially registered all [[Soulbound]] on the continent.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c5">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The characters have traveled throughout [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c6">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The [[Blackwatch]] studies [[Elders]] to defend [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c8">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[The Empire]] holds a deep hatred for the [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c9">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[The Empire]] is ruled by an Elderspawned ruler.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c15">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[The Empire]] is at risk of civilization disappearing if no one directs it.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c16">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 16</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|As a governing body, [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]] faces internal instability because various [[Guilds]] fail to cooperate with one another. This political entity struggles with legitimacy, as certain villages feel excluded from its reach. While [[Calder]]'s crew shows a willingness to defy [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]], the loyal [[Guilds]] remain committed to protecting the people. Ultimately, [[Calder]] intends to steer the direction of [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]]'s politics.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[The Empire]] is at risk of falling apart due to a lack of cooperation between [[Guilds]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c8">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[The Empire]] is a governing body that some villages feel they are not truly part of.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c9">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Calder]]'s crew was willing to defy [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c12">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The loyal [[Guilds]] of [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]] will protect the people.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c14">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[The Empire]] is a political entity that [[Calder]] intends to steer.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c23">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 23</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[The Empire]] is a political entity that encompasses the town of [[Silverreach]] and operates under the influence of the Emperor. Although it serves as an organization that the [[Consultants]] might potentially join, [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]] is currently weakening and has begun to collapse in on itself. This state of instability has led the [[Great Elders]] to seek its total destruction.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The Emperor has an influence on [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c4">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[The Empire]] is a political entity containing the town of [[Silverreach]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c7">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[The Empire]] is described as weak and having collapsed in on itself.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c19">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 19</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Great Elders]] want to destroy [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c21">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 21</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[The Empire]] is weakening.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c22">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[The Empire]] is an organization that the [[Consultants]] might join.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c22" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Identified by the moon-in-sun emblem, [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]] is a political entity referenced during [[Cheska Bennett{{!}}Cheska]]'s accounts. The state stands to gain significantly from the return of the crown, particularly if it is ruled by a leader possessing a human lifespan. Ultimately, [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]]'s military and administrative forces appeared to maintain control over their affairs.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[The Empire]]'s emblem is the moon-in-sun.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c5">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[The Empire]] is a political entity mentioned by [[Cheska Bennett{{!}}Cheska]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c9">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[The Empire]] would benefit from the return of the crown.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c12">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Being ruled by someone of human lifespan would benefit [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 19</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The forces of [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]] appeared to have things well in hand.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 24</ref>}}</li>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|said. “We’ve already divided into regions, under the four Regents.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c17" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|“The Empire is weakening,” he said, walking the border between passion and insubordinate anger.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c22" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|“Haven’t I served the Empire all this time?”<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|“From the beginning, I was willing to go to prison to serve the Empire,” Lucan said.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c21" />}}
